spindle.wording_drift: the #107 body says only 'inside' (内圈); README later says 'inner and middle zones' (内、中圈). The 'middle' qualifier is a README refinement, not body text.
spindle.conflict: docs/KNOWLEDGE.md:233 reads the same 9705 rpm as 'equals 12x at 58 mm (9714 rpm)'; README/body say 9705 rpm belongs to the INNER and MIDDLE zones. If 9705 rpm is at r=26 mm, the linear speed is 26.4 m/s ~= 5.4x; if at 58 mm it is 58.9 m/s ~= 12x. Which radius the 9705 was observed at is UNRESOLVED.
spindle.confidence: rpm values are quoted; their radius attribution is contradictory across two in-repo sources

transfer_rate.consistency: 1655 rpm at r=56.8 mm gives 9.84 m/s ~= 2.0x of 4.917 m/s, matching the quoted 'about 2x'. 9705 rpm does not correspond to 2x at any radius inside the disc, so the 9705 must be either an inner ZCLV zone at much higher linear speed or a mis-attributed reading.

reports.why_bd_fails_stated: The drive ignores SET CD SPEED (0xBB returns OK but rpm does not change for DVD-RW at 5540/2770/1385), rejects SET STREAMING (0xB6) with sense 5/24/00 'Invalid field in CDB' across many descriptor variants, and its Pioneer vendor Quiet-Mode/Speed-Limit commands are readable and writable yet change no rpm. Read speed is therefore fixed by firmware per disc type, and on BD-R the resulting mode is CLV/mixed rather than CAV.
reports.supporting_doc: https://gist.github.com/bczhc/0323c1762b0d47a46b59159a83353703 (fetched in full; DVD-RW-focused, explains the BD speed-control dead end)
reports.confidence_overall: medium: rpm and 'about 2x' are quoted second-hand with a permalink, but the zone attribution conflicts with KNOWLEDGE.md and the comment body was not readable.
